question: Where’s the closest restaurant aligned with the route to Hotel Indigo, Naperville, IL from IIT Stuart School of Business, Chicago, IL?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%IIT Stuart School of Business%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hotel Indigo%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Naperville%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1 ), route_line AS ( -- Create a straight line segment between the start and end points SELECT ST_MakeLine(sp.geometry, ep.geometry) AS geom FROM start_point sp, end_point ep ), buffered_route AS ( -- Create a 1000-meter buffer around the straight line route to define "aligned with the route" SELECT ST_Buffer(rl.geom::geography, 1000) AS geom FROM route_line rl ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, route_line rl WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' -- Filter for restaurants that intersect the buffered route AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geom FROM buffered_route)::geography) ORDER BY -- Order by the distance from the restaurant to the straight line route ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, rl.geom::geography) LIMIT 1;
